aiVerification.summary: Draft captures the mold-validation topic but misgroups conditions and includes unreliable extracted outcomes.
issues: Changed factor includes invalid TOTAL condition and unclear baseline/test split.
VP #11 and VP #12 outcomes are merged despite different final decisions.
NG rate pairings appear row-misaligned and rate fields are unreliable.
FO and acoustic measurement outcomes include extraction artifacts from labels/header rows.
Decision and purpose rows are not used as primary evidence.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as VP new mold #11 and #12 validation against normal VP or ST context.
Separate conclusions for mold #11 and mold #12 under the same report context.
Rebuild NG rate outcomes from the correct table headers, totals, and rate columns.
Remove artifact measurement outcomes unless valid grouped measurement tables can be cited.
Add concise citations to title, purpose, NG result sections, and final decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient until grouping and table interpretation are corrected.
